runs.name: Everything works
runs.summary: Stock is reserved, payment is captured, delivery is arranged, and fresh provider evidence confirms the order is complete.

runs.name: The payment reply is lost
runs.summary: The charge happened but its reply vanished. The system checks the provider instead of charging twice, then safely continues.

runs.name: Delivery fails after payment
runs.summary: Inventory and payment succeed, but fulfillment rejects the order. The Saga cancels delivery, refunds payment, and releases stock in reverse order.

runs.name: The refund cannot be verified
runs.summary: The refund reply remains uncertain. The Saga pauses, rejects stale and unauthorized decisions, then resumes only after trusted human verification.
